arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values in billions of dollars
fy_1981 = 82.590  # billion dollars
fy_1980 = 64.564  # billion dollars (comparable period)

# Box-Cox transformation with lambda = 0.75
# Formula: (x^lambda - 1) / lambda when lambda != 0
lambda_val = 0.75

def box_cox(x, lambda_val):
    return (x ** lambda_val - 1) / lambda_val

bc_1981 = box_cox(fy_1981, lambda_val)
bc_1980 = box_cox(fy_1980, lambda_val)

print(f"FY 1981 value: {fy_1981} billion")
print(f"FY 1980 value: {fy_1980} billion")
print(f"\nBox-Cox (lambda=0.75) transformed:")
print(f"FY 1981: {bc_1981}")
print(f"FY 1980: {bc_1980}")

# Calculate difference (1981 - 1980)
difference = bc_1981 - bc_1980

print(f"\nDifference (1981 - 1980): {difference}")

# Round to 4 decimal places
difference_rounded = round(difference, 4)
print(f"Rounded to 4 decimal places: {difference_rounded}")
EOF
